义项: 形容词 与政府收支相关的（fiscal vulnerability 财政脆弱性）
[辨析] fiscal policy 财政政策（税收与支出）≠ monetary policy 货币政策

例句.英文: Mauricio Drelichman and Hans-Joachim Voth's research on the fiscal vulnerability of Philip Ⅱ (who ruled not only Spain but other regions including much of Belgium from 1556 to 1598) builds on other studies of European early modern state finance, including Hoffman and Norberg's work on the relationship between state finance and political development.
例句.中文: Mauricio Drelichman 与 Hans-Joachim Voth 对腓力二世财政脆弱性的研究……

义项: 名词 某事物所涉及的范围（the broad scope 宽泛的范围）
名词 (引申义) 机会、余地（scope for improvement 改进空间）

例句.英文: Encompassing both early (e.g., Fritz Leiber's 1950 story "Coming Attraction") and more recent (e.g., Erica Satifka's 2021 story "Act of Providence") contributions, the broad chronological scope of Shurin's volume may make it seem more comprehensive than Mirrorshades, but Mirrorshades's focus is more carefully considered, rendering it the more authoritative anthology of this science fiction subgenre.
例句.中文: 这部文集既收录早期作品（如弗里茨·莱伯 1950 年的《即将到来的吸引力》），也收录较新的作品（如埃丽卡·萨蒂夫卡 2021 年的《天意之举》），范围宽泛。

例句.英文: The anthology has a vast chronological scope, including both James Tiptree Jr.’s “The Girl Who Was Plugged In” (1973) and Lavanya Lakshminarayanan’s “Etudes” (2020).
例句.中文: 这部选集年代跨度极大，既收录了 James Tiptree Jr. 的《插电女孩》（1973），也收录了 Lavanya Lakshminarayanan 的《练习曲》（2020）。

义项: 名词 企业或个人在一定期间赚得的钱（opening weekend earnings 首周末票房）
[辨析] 常用复数；与 revenue（营收）不同，earnings 更接近利润

例句.英文: A student claims that opening weekend earnings can reliably predict whether a film will be nominated for an Oscar: films that draw large audiences at the beginning of their release are the most likely contenders to earn these coveted award nominations.
例句.中文: 一名学生声称，一部电影的首周末票房能够可靠地预测它是否会获得奥斯卡提名。

例句.英文: The team found that the greater the exposure to sunshine at work in the two weeks before a manager submitted an earnings forecast, the more the manager’s forecast exceeded what the company actually earned that year.
例句.中文: 团队发现：管理者提交盈利预测前两周在工作中晒的太阳越多，其预测超出公司当年实际盈利的幅度就越大。

义项: 名词 军队中的专业兵种编制（a military bicycle corps 军事自行车部队）
[辨析] 与 corpse（尸体）拼写相近，注意区分；复数 corps 读音不变

例句.英文: The goal was to test the idea of forming a military bicycle corps.
例句.中文: 其目标是检验组建一支军事自行车部队的构想。

义项: 名词 大型水上运输工具（a merchant vessel 商船）
名词 (引申义) 容器；血管（blood vessel 血管）

例句.英文: A merchant vessel is any ship hired to carry cargo or passengers.
例句.中文: 商船是指任何受雇运送货物或乘客的船舶。

例句.英文: Such decorations came to be a defining feature of Germ an stoneware vessels of the period.
例句.中文: 这类装饰后来成为该时期德国炻器器皿的标志性特征。

义项: 名词 提供水、电、燃气等公共服务的机构（the regional electric utility 地区电力公司）
名词 (引申义) 效用、实用性（practical utility 实用价值）

例句.英文: Beatrice Ehmann and her colleagues hypothesized that this difference in life trajectory should be reflected in the diets of immature orangutans: males should share fewer of their mothers’ dietary preferences than females do since those preferences tend to be particular to the food resources available in the local area and may be of relatively low utility beyond it.
例句.中文: 当用电需求低迷时，地区电力公司核电站的多余电力被用来把水从下水库抽到山顶湖储存。

例句.英文: Extensive travels abroad later sparked an engagement with modernist and functionalist aesthetics—styles whose emphasis on utility and whose repudiation of traditional architecture's more ornamental elements are readily apparent in Barragán's house in Calle Guadiana.
例句.中文: 广泛的海外游历随后引燃了他对现代主义与功能主义美学的倾心——这两种风格对实用的强调、对传统建筑繁复装饰元素的摒弃，在巴拉干的瓜迪亚纳街住宅中清晰可见。

义项: 名词 中世纪受封的武装骑兵（Arthur's knights 亚瑟王的骑士）
[辨析] 与 night（夜晚）同音；动词义「授予爵位」

例句.英文: But while no source before 1155 includes references to the famous Round Table at which Arthur’s knights assembled, both the Roman de Brut and Sir Thomas Malory’s 15th-century compilation of Arthurian legends, Le Morte d’Arthur, do.
例句.中文: 尽管 1155 年之前没有任何文献提及亚瑟的骑士们聚集的那张著名圆桌，但《布鲁特传奇》与托马斯·马洛礼 15 世纪的著作都……

例句.英文: While neither History nor any works that predate it mention Arthur's famous Round Table at which his knights assembled, Le Morte d'Arthur does, suggesting that ​​​​​​​.
例句.中文: 尽管《不列颠诸王史》及更早的作品均未提及亚瑟著名的圆桌，骑士们环坐其旁，《亚瑟王之死》却写了它，这提示……

义项: 名词 以运输为业的船或公司（bulk carriers 散货船）
名词 (引申义) 载体、携带者（a disease carrier 带菌者）

例句.英文: Common merchant vessels include bulk carriers, cruise liners, and oil tankers.
例句.中文: 常见的商船包括散货船、邮轮和油轮。

例句.英文: “John of God, the Water-Carrier” is a 1913 short story by María Cristina Mena.
例句.中文: 《担水人约翰的神》是玛丽亚·克里斯蒂娜·梅纳 1913 年的短篇小说。

义项: 名词 可不断衍生续作的知识产权（franchise films 系列电影）
名词 (引申义) 特许经营权；选举权（the franchise 选举权）

例句.英文: But the flow seems to have increased significantly since the early 2010s, with franchise films like Minions and Jurassic World Dominion flooding movie screens.
例句.中文: 但自 2010 年代初以来，这股潮流似乎显著增强，《小黄人大眼萌》《侏罗纪世界：统治》等系列电影大量涌上银幕。

例句.英文: Critics generally agree that Spider-Man: Far From Home isn't the most exciting franchise movie, but franchise movies are rarely as stale as some people claim.
例句.中文: 评论界普遍认同《蜘蛛侠：英雄远征》并非最激动人心的系列电影，但系列电影也很少像某些人声称的那样陈腐。

义项: 形容词 满足规定条件因而可享有的（eligible citizens 合格选民）
[辨析] be eligible for sth 有资格获得；反义 ineligible

例句.英文: All fifty state constitutions contain clauses that confer the right to vote on eligible citizens..
例句.中文: 五十个州的宪法都含有条款，赋予合格公民投票权。

义项: 形容词 仅此一个的（relying solely on GDP 仅依赖 GDP）
[辨析] 与 soul（灵魂）同音；solely 仅仅

例句.英文: By assessing indicators in multiple domains—such as social relationships and professional and community activity—rather than relying solely on GDP, the United Kingdom gains a truer understanding of its national well-being.
例句.中文: 通过评估多个领域的指标——如社会关系、职业与社区活动——而不是仅依赖 GDP，英国得以……

例句.英文: These plants were well suited to the hot, dry climate of Pangaea, the sole landmass on Earth at the time.
例句.中文: 这些植物非常适应当时地球上唯一的陆块——盘古大陆——炎热干燥的气候。

义项: 名词 向当局提出诉求的联名文书（collecting signatures for a petition 为请愿书征集签名）
动词 请愿、正式请求（petition the court 向法院申请）

例句.英文: Louis Pipestone is collecting signatures for a petition from fellow members of the Turtle Mountain Band of Chippewa on the tribe's reservation in North Dakota. Louis Pipestone tended the petition like a garden.
例句.中文: 路易斯·派普斯通正在北达科他州奇珀瓦龟山保留地，为一份请愿书向同部落成员征集签名。

例句.英文: Geologist and scholar John Bostock joined with 55 other prominent British writers in 1837 to petition the US Congress for greater copyright protections.
例句.中文: 地质学家兼学者 John Bostock 于 1837 年联同另外 55 位英国知名作家，向美国国会请愿加强版权保护。

义项: 形容词 与理性思维相关的（intellectual virtue 智识上的美德）
名词 知识分子（a public intellectual 公共知识分子）

例句.英文: Perhaps it is a little depressing to inherit not lands but an example of intellectual virtue; perhaps the conclusiveness of a great ancestor is a little discouraging to those who run the risk of comparison with him.
例句.中文: 也许，继承的不是田产而是一份智识美德的典范，多少令人沮丧；也许一位伟大祖先那种无可辩驳的定论，会让后人有些气馁。

例句.英文: A salon is a social gathering for the exploration of intellectual ideas.It was evening when the two men got up to leave.
例句.中文: 沙龙是探讨思想智识的社交聚会。两人起身告辞时，已是入夜时分。

义项: 动词 stem from 由…造成（stems from the emphasis 源于那种强调）
名词 茎、梗；词干（word stem 词干）

例句.英文: The prominent featuring of metal stems from the post–World War II emphasis on technological progress, while more traditional natural materials help preserve longstanding architectural and aesthetic approaches.
例句.中文: 金属之所以被突出使用，源于二战后对技术进步的强调；而更传统的天然材料则有助于维系长久以来的……

例句.英文: Established knowledge of prehistoric societies primarily stems from analysis of durable historical artifacts, including gold jewelry pieces, but Ingrid Bertin and team have contributed new insights with a unique analysis of plant-based items.
例句.中文: 关于史前社会的既有认识主要来自对耐久历史器物（含黄金饰品）的分析；而 Ingrid Bertin 团队凭借对植物制品的独特分析贡献了新洞见。

义项: 名词 山的最高处（mountain summits 山峰）
名词 (引申义) 峰会、最高级会议（a climate summit 气候峰会）

例句.英文: Mountain summits are often described in terms of their elevation, or height above sea level.
例句.中文: 山峰常以其海拔——即高出海平面的高度——来描述。

例句.英文: For example, people will always remember that Alessandra Boarelli was a mountaineer and the first woman to summit Monviso in the Italian Alps.
例句.中文: 例如，人们将永远记得亚历山德拉·博阿尔迪是一位登山家，是登顶意大利阿尔卑斯蒙维索峰的第一位女性。

义项: 名词 待办事项或预设的目标清单（a prescriptive agenda 规定性的议程）
名词 (引申义) （隐藏的）意图、政治议程（a hidden agenda 隐藏动机）

例句.英文: … she seeks to cultivate a practice of “constant evolution” untethered from any prescriptive agenda …
例句.中文: 此外，她力图培养一种不受任何规定性议程束缚的「持续演化」的实践，使自己的艺术游走于传统与……之间的临界地带。

义项: 形容词 值得警惕的（a grave threat 严重威胁）
名词 /ɡreɪv/ 坟墓；注意与 gravel（砾石）区分

例句.英文: Good-Bye to All That is a 1929 autobiography by writer Robert Graves.
例句.中文: 《向一切告别》是作家罗伯特·格雷夫斯 1929 年出版的自传。

义项: 动词 揭示、使…明朗（≈ shed light on / illuminate）——His memoirs possibly cast light on this enigma 回忆录或许能揭开这个谜；真题中「照亮谜团 / 难题」的固定搭配
动词 令人对…产生怀疑（casting doubt on the feasibility of… 令人怀疑…的可行性）——真题中 cast 出现频率最高的短语
动词 casts nonprofessional actors 起用非职业演员；cast and crew 演职员（Star Trek 句）；the film's cast 主演阵容
名词 cast-iron 铸铁的（a cast-iron opinion 毫不动摇的看法）；casting 光影投射（a stage light casting his silhouette 舞台灯把剪影投在幕布上）——真题各考过一次，按语境取义
搭配说明: casts — 第三人称单数 · 真题 12 次（casts doubt on / casts nonprofessional actors）
casting — 现在分词 / 动名词 · 真题 17 次（casting his silhouette / casting director 选角导演）
同句复盘 — 与 570 enigma 共用同一真题句——cast 高亮词组 cast light on，enigma 高亮 this enigma

例句.英文: His recently published memoirs possibly cast light on this enigma, but given that such details were not provided until after the thirty-page mark, they might as well have remained state secrets.
例句.中文: 他新出版的回忆录或许能照亮（cast light on）这个谜团，但由于这些细节直到第三十页之后才出现，它们还不如继续当国家机密算了。

例句.英文: Though Chloé Zhao's films are fictional, she incorporates real events into them in a documentary-like style and casts nonprofessional actors who reside in the places that she aims to portray.
例句.中文: 虽然赵婷的电影是虚构的，但她以近乎纪录片的方式将真实事件融入其中，并起用（casts）居住在故事发生地的非职业演员。

义项: 名词 某一知识或活动的界域（multiple domains 多个领域）
名词 (引申义) 领地、域名（public domain 公有领域）

例句.英文: Carl Woese’s 1970s study of methanogens (microbes with no nuclei, such as Methanococcus vannielii, that metabolize hydrogen and carbon dioxide in oxygen-poor environments and produce methane as a by-product) suggested that they did not fit scientists’ then-conventional division of life into two domains, the eukaryotes (having cells with nuclei) and the prokaryotes (missing nuclei).
例句.中文: Carl Woese 在 20 世纪 70 年代对产甲烷菌（一类无细胞核的微生物，如 Methanococcus vannielii，在缺氧环境中代谢氢与二氧化碳并产生甲烷副产物）的研究表明：它们并不符合当时科学界把生命分为两个域的常规分法——真核生物（细胞有核）与原核生物（无核）。

例句.英文: Molecular clock evidence indicated that what Woese argued was a third domain of life emerged as early as 3.5 billion years ago.
例句.中文: 分子钟证据显示：伍斯主张的「生命第三域」，早至 35 亿年前便已出现。

义项: 名词 对某事的关注与介入（civic engagement 公民参与）
名词 (引申义) 订婚；约定、预约

例句.英文: For example, though young adults don’t always view themselves as essential parties in such matters, reminders of their collective role as future inheritors of problems left unsolved can spark their engagement.
例句.中文: 例如，尽管年轻人并不总把自己视为这类事务的关键参与方，但提醒他们作为问题未来继承者的集体角色……

例句.英文: This approach to research can promote community engagement by offering insight into the daily life of a scientist.
例句.中文: 这种研究方法通过让人一窥科学家的日常，能够促进社群参与。

义项: 名词 高校中从事教学研究的人员（college faculty 大学教师）
名词 (引申义) 官能、能力（mental faculties 心智能力）

例句.英文: In 1979 Daniel Kahneman and Amos Tversky presented college students and faculty from Israel, Sweden, and the United States with hypothetical questions involving financial decisions.
例句.中文: 1979 年，Daniel Kahneman 与 Amos Tversky 向来自以色列、瑞典和美国的大学生与大学教师提出涉及财务的假设性问题。

例句.英文: Other faculty resist this narrow scope, calling instead for an interdisciplinary approach that includes African history, economics, and politics..
例句.中文: 另一些教师抵制这种狭隘的定位，转而呼吁包含非洲历史、经济与政治的跨学科路径。

义项: 名词 浪漫的情感关系（objects of romance 爱情的对象）
名词 (引申义) 传奇故事；浪漫色彩（the romance of travel 旅行的浪漫）

例句.英文: These superheroines were marginalized in action-oriented plots, serving instead as objects of romance or rescue.
例句.中文: 这些女超级英雄在动作主导的情节中被边缘化，只是作为恋爱或等待被拯救的对象出现。

例句.英文: Most other contemporaneous personal manuscripts like the Findern Anthology (FA) consist primarily of pieces for polite society like genteel romances and other readings favored by elites, whereas the HM has a distinctive emphasis on the popular, including entertainments like nonsense verse, and the practical, with advice about religion.
例句.中文: 同时代的其他个人抄本（如芬德恩选集）主要由迎合上流社会的作品构成——文雅的爱情故事与精英偏爱的读物；而 HM 抄本却独特地偏重通俗与实用：既有打油诗之类的娱乐，也有关于宗教的劝诫。

义项: 名词 经济或需求的快速扩张（a cattle ranching boom 养牛业的繁荣）
名词 隆隆声；动词「迅速发展」

例句.英文: Due to the Chorotega region's accessibility, various types of forested areas were converted to cattle pasture as rising international meat prices drove a cattle ranching boom in the 1960s and 1970s.
例句.中文: 由于乔罗特加地区交通便利，随着国际肉类价格上涨带动养牛业繁荣，各类林地被改造成牧场。

例句.英文: Those studying the works of Augusto Roa Bastos, for instance, may inadvertently overlook nuances in his work by focusing only on the most obvious ways in which his style corresponds to the Latin American Boom.
例句.中文: 例如，研究奥古斯托·罗亚·巴斯托斯的学者若只关注其风格与「拉美文学爆炸」最明显的对应，就可能无意间忽略作品中的细微之处。

义项: 名词 对自然资源的可持续管理（environmental conservation 环境保护）
[辨析] conservation 强调「保护以免损耗」；preservation 强调「保持原状」

例句.英文: Tarabieh conducted a study of consumer attitudes toward Jordanian food and beverage companies and found that for consumers who value environmental conservation, their likelihood of purchasing a product decreased when their perception of the product's risk of causing environmental harm increased.
例句.中文: 塔拉比耶研究了约旦食品饮料企业的消费者态度，发现对于重视环境保护的消费者而言，他们的喜好……

例句.英文: They must use the best information available to decide which species are most threatened and therefore most in need of conservation efforts.
例句.中文: 他们必须依据现有的最佳信息，判断哪些物种受威胁最深、因而最需要保护行动。

义项: 名词 为劳动或损失支付的款项（fair compensation 公平报酬）
名词 (引申义) 补偿机制（psychological compensation 心理补偿）

例句.英文: It advocates for fair treatment of and compensation for food production workers..
例句.中文: 该组织倡导公平对待食品生产从业者并给予其公平报酬。

义项: 名词 按自身意愿行动的权利（the liberty to assign weight 自由赋予权重）
[辨析] 与 freedom 近义；take the liberty of 冒昧地做某事

例句.英文: Economists Benjamin Enke et al. propose that values are a luxury good: that is, the higher one's income, the more weight one has the liberty to assign to one's values when voting.
例句.中文: 经济学家 Benjamin Enke 等人提出，价值观是一种奢侈品：收入越高，人们在分配价值权重时就越有自由。

例句.英文: It was the end of Paris, the beginning of the country, and behind the double row of arches the Seine, suddenly spreading out as though it had regained space and liberty, became all at once the peaceful river which flows through the plains, alongside the wooded hills, amid the meadows, along the edge of the forests.
例句.中文: 这是巴黎的尽头、乡野的起点；双排拱廊之后，塞纳河骤然铺展开来，仿佛重获了空间与自由，霎时变成那条流经平原的安详之河——傍着林木葱茏的山丘，穿行于草场之间，依着森林的边缘。

义项: 名词 从原价中减去的部分（signs of a discount 打折的标志）
动词 /dɪsˈkaʊnt/ 打折；引申「轻视、不予采信」（discount a claim 不采信某说法）

例句.英文: In many cases, shoppers respond as intended, viewing such prices as signs of a discount or special offer.
例句.中文: 在许多情况下，消费者的反应正如商家所愿，把这类价格视为打折或促销的标志。

义项: 名词 派驻他国的最高外交代表（the US ambassador 美国大使）
名词 (引申义) 代表、使者（a goodwill ambassador 亲善大使）

例句.英文: Both are works by proven masters-James had published The Portrait ofa Lady (1881);Scorsese had directed Taxi Driver (1976)—who began to make demanding works, such as James's The Ambassadors (1903) and Scorsese's Silence (2016),that ask more of their audiences than their earlier works do but give more in return.
例句.中文: 两者都出自已被证明的大师之手——詹姆斯已出版《一位女士的画像》（1881），斯科塞斯已执导《出租车司机》（1976）——而他们随后都开始创作要求更高的作品。

义项: 名词 为解决某问题而发起的计划（initiatives that rely on natural features 依托自然特征的倡议）
名词 (引申义) 主动性、进取心（take the initiative 主动出击）

例句.英文: Conservationists worldwide are working to protect ecosystems from habitat destruction and biodiversity loss, and in many cases, initiatives that rely on natural features or processes can help address such challenges.
例句.中文: 世界各地的保育工作者正努力保护生态系统免遭栖息地破坏与生物多样性丧失，许多倡议依托自然特征……

例句.英文: A premortem is an exercise in which teams imagine their initiative has already failed, then brainstorm possible reasons for that failure.
例句.中文: 事前验尸是一种练习：团队假想自己的计划已经失败，然后头脑风暴失败的可能原因。

义项: 名词 努力所要达成的结果（a key objective 关键目标）
形容词 /əbˈdʒektɪv/ 客观的（objective documentation 客观记录）

例句.英文: Increasing stony coral colonies worldwide is a key objective for ecologists, since land-based runoff and other pressures are causing growing harm to reefs.
例句.中文: 增加全球石珊瑚群落数量是生态学者的关键目标，因为陆源径流及其他压力正日益损害珊瑚礁。

义项: 名词 从过去传承下来的文化或自然财富（the National Heritage Fellowship 国家传统艺术基金）
[辨析] heritage 强调「传承下来的文化资产」；inheritance 强调「继承的财产」

例句.英文: The National Heritage Fellowship was created to raise public awareness about exceptional folk and traditional artists in the United States.
例句.中文: 国家传统艺术基金的设立，旨在提高公众对美国杰出民间与传统艺术家的认识。

例句.英文: From the traditional stories of the Kanaka Maoli, or Native Hawaiian people, to the works of writers such as David Malo, the literary heritage of Hawaiʻi is distinctive and vibrant.
例句.中文: 从卡纳卡毛利人（即夏威夷原住民）的传统故事，到 David Malo 等作家的作品，夏威夷的文学遗产独特而生机勃勃。

义项: 名词 某一语言使用的书写体系（the cuneiform script 楔形文字）
名词 (引申义) 剧本；笔迹；动词「编写剧本」

例句.英文: … to be written using the cuneiform script …
例句.中文: 苏美尔语是最早使用楔形文字书写的语言之一。

义项: 名词 前人留下并持续产生影响的事物（the legacy of the painter 那位画家的遗产）
[辨析] 与 heritage 近义，但 legacy 更强调「留下的影响」而非「被继承的传统」

例句.英文: The image calls attention to the album’s title song, in which Mitchell sings about the legacy of the postimpressionist painter.
例句.中文: 这张图像使人注意到专辑的同名歌曲——米切尔在其中歌唱那位后印象派画家的遗产。

例句.英文: As mastermind of the university’s architecture and curriculum, Jefferson assured that his legacy was sound.
例句.中文: 作为大学建筑与课程的总设计师，杰斐逊确保了自己留下的遗产根基稳固。

义项: 名词 一国流通的交换媒介（foreign currency reserves 外汇储备）
名词 (引申义) 通用、流行（gain currency 流传开来）

例句.英文: In pre-Columbian Mesoamerica, obsidian was used as a commodity currency.
例句.中文: 在前哥伦布时期的中美洲，黑曜石曾被用作商品货币（commodity currency）。

例句.英文: "Culture" has considerable currency among sociologists but has no fixed definition: it might include art, or laws, or one of several other concepts.
例句.中文: 「文化」在社会学家中颇为流行，却没有固定定义：它可能包括艺术、法律，或若干其他概念中的任何一种。

义项: 名词 货物与服务的大规模交换（the Commerce Department 商务部）
[辨析] 与 trade 近义，commerce 更正式、更强调体系性

例句.英文: 1926: The US Congress gave the US Commerce Department authority to regulate safety standards in the fledgling commercial airline industry.
例句.中文: 1926 年，美国国会授权商务部监管新兴商业航空业的安全标准。

例句.英文: Featuring contributions from Zulema Valdez, Bea Stotzer, and others, it explores contemporary issues while also providing context dating all the way back to the sixteenth century on Latino populations and their experiences with business and commerce.
例句.中文: 本书由 Zulema Valdez、Bea Stotzer 等人撰稿，既探讨当代议题，也把拉美裔人口及其商贸经历的历史脉络一路追溯至十六世纪。

义项: 动词 resort to 不得已而采用（resorted to cheaper forms 转而采用更廉价的形式）
名词 /rɪˈzɔːt/ 度假地；凭借、手段（as a last resort 作为最后手段）

例句.英文: Eventually, ningyo joruri productions resorted to cheaper forms of puppetry, such as kuruma ningyo, which involves only one puppeteer.
例句.中文: 最终，人形净琉璃的演出转而采用更廉价的木偶形式，如只需一名操偶师的「车人形」。

例句.英文: … rather than leveraging the medium’s potential to confront difficult truths, filmmakers and studios often resorted to platitudes about contemporary US society.
例句.中文: ……电影人与制片厂往往不去发掘这一媒介直面残酷真相的潜力，而是退而堆砌关于美国当代社会的陈词滥调。

义项: 名词 公开交流意见的平台（provide a forum for 为…提供论坛）
名词 古罗马的公共广场

例句.英文: Since its beginning, NEC has provided a forum for the voices of Harrison and other Black playwrights through workshops and performances.
例句.中文: 自成立以来，NEC 通过工作坊与演出，为哈里森及其他黑人剧作家的声音提供了论坛。

例句.英文: The 1948 founding of the American GI Forum and the 1946 Mendez v.
例句.中文: 1948 年美国退伍军人 GI 论坛的创立，以及 1946 年的门德斯诉……案……

义项: 名词 从事经营的组织（a business enterprise 商业企业）
名词 (引申义) 事业心、进取精神（a spirit of enterprise 进取精神）

例句.英文: … prohibited from holding excess interests in a business enterprise …
例句.中文: 私人基金会不得在企业中持有超额权益，不得从事「自我交易」，也不得进行应税支出。

义项: 名词 为共同目的结成的团体（the silversword alliance 银剑菊类群）
[辨析] 与 coalition 近义，alliance 更强调长期的利益结合

例句.英文: Dubautia raillardioides is a species in a family of plants known collectively as the silversword alliance, all of which grow only on the Hawaiian Islands.
例句.中文: Dubautia raillardioides 是植物学上统称为「银剑菊类群」的一个科中的物种，它们全部只生长在夏威夷群岛。

例句.英文: Members of this alliance exhibit an extraordinary range of phenotypes, with some species maturing into vines and others into shrubs and trees.
例句.中文: 这一联盟的成员表型极为多样：有的物种长成藤本，有的长成灌木或乔木。

义项: 名词 拥有优势地位的小群体（readings favored by elites 精英阶层偏爱的读物）
形容词 精英的、顶尖的（an elite university 顶尖大学）

例句.英文: Most other contemporaneous personal manuscripts like the Findern Anthology (FA) consist primarily of pieces by celebrated medieval authors like Hoccleve and other readings favored by elites, whereas the HM has a distinctive emphasis on the popular, including entertainments like crude comedies, and the practical, with advice about manners.​​​​​​​
例句.中文: 其他同时期的私人手稿主要由著名中世纪作家的作品以及精英阶层偏爱的读物组成。

义项: 副词 按前述顺序一一对应（71 seconds and 87 seconds respectively 分别为 71 秒与 87 秒
[辨析] respectively 要求前后项严格按顺序对应；respective 为形容词

例句.英文: When exposed to the treatment, cinnabar moth caterpillars and scarce vapourer moth caterpillars remained coiled in a defensive position for an average of 71 seconds and 87 seconds, respectively, whereas European peacock butterfly caterpillars continued to flail defensively for 20 seconds.
例句.中文: 接触处理物后，朱砂蛾与稀薄尺蛾的幼虫平均分别保持防御卷曲姿势 71 秒与 87 秒。

例句.英文: Subjects included flies identified by mutations silencing DptA, DptB, or both DptA and DptB (termed types A, B, and AB, respectively).
例句.中文: 受试果蝇包括 DptA 被沉默突变体、DptB 被沉默突变体，以及两者同时被沉默的突变体（分别称为 A 型、B 型与 AB 型）。

义项: 名词 作品或人的初次登场（debut novels 处女作小说）
[辨析] make one's debut 首次亮相；注意法语来源，t 不发音

例句.英文: Debut novels are especially interesting to literary critics (people whose job it is to evaluate books) and readers because these books offer a look at new voices in the literary world.
例句.中文: 处女作小说尤其令文学批评家与读者感兴趣，因为这些书让人得以一窥文学界的新声音。

例句.英文: Argentum debuted in 2018 at the Bronx Museum of the Arts in New York City, New York..
例句.中文: 《Argentum》于 2018 年在纽约市布朗克斯艺术博物馆首展。

义项: 名词 依法拘押（the recent arrest of his brother 他兄弟近来的被捕）
动词 (引申义) 阻止、抑制（arrest the decline 遏止下滑）；吸引（arrest attention 引起注意）

例句.英文: Richard is reflecting on the recent arrest of his brother, the Duke of Clarence, on suspicion of treason against King Edward IV.
例句.中文: 理查德正在回想兄长——克拉伦斯公爵——近日因涉嫌叛国而被捕一事。

义项: 形容词 仅限于特定对象或来源的（almost exclusively derives from biological sources 几乎只来自生物来源）
形容词 (引申义) 高档的、专属的（an exclusive club 高级会所）

例句.英文: Despite potential independent confirmation, the apparent detection in 2020 of phosphine (PH₃)—a gas that on Earth almost exclusively derives from biological sources—in Venus’s cloud deck remains controversial, in part because Venus is thought to be uninhabitable.
例句.中文: 尽管可能存在独立验证，2020 年对磷化氢（一种在地球上几乎只来自生物来源的气体）的表观探测……

例句.英文: This cactus thrives exclusively in the specific climate conditions found within a certain state, with documented occurrences limited to the central region of the state.
例句.中文: 这种仙人掌只在某州境内的特定气候条件下繁茂生长，有记录的分布仅限于该州中部地区。

义项: 名词 用以衡量某现象的量化标准（indexed by age bracket 按年龄段编制指数）
名词 (引申义) 索引；动词「编制索引、按指数调整」

例句.英文: The table presents percentages of people who make particular kinds of New Year's resolutions among those who choose to make them, indexed by age bracket.
例句.中文: 该表呈现的是：在愿意制定新年计划的人群中，各类计划所占的百分比，并按年龄段编制指数。

例句.英文: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​P50—the pressure in the xylem (water‑conducting tissue) at which a plant loses 50% of its hydraulic conductivity due to embolisms (air bubbles in the water flow)—is a key index of xylem embolism resistance and, by extension, tolerance of water stress; lower P50 values indicate lower vulnerability to xylem embolisms.
例句.中文: P50——植物木质部（输水组织）因栓塞（水流中的气泡）而失去 50% 导水率时的压力——是木质部抗栓塞能力、进而也是耐旱能力的关键指标；P50 越低，木质部越不易栓塞。

义项: 名词 有组织的安排或计划（the small world's scheme 这个小世界的运作方式）
[辨析] 英式英语中 scheme 常中性指「方案」；美式常含「阴谋」色彩

例句.英文: At night in bed I rehearsed the small world’s scheme and set challenges: Find the store using backyards only.
例句.中文: 夜里躺在床上，我反复推演这个小世界的运作方式，并给自己设下挑战：只靠后院找到那家商店。

例句.英文: Scheme is referred to as a compiled programming language because it typically incorporates a compiler—a tool that translates lines of code into executable commands.
例句.中文: Scheme 之所以被称为编译型语言，是因为它通常内置编译器——一种把代码行翻译成可执行指令的工具。

义项: 名词 正式通过的决定，或坚定的意愿（New Year's resolutions 新年决心）
名词 (引申义) （图像）分辨率；解决（conflict resolution 冲突解决）

例句.英文: Hydrologist Yonghong Yi and her colleagues modeled seasonal changes in net CO₂ in Alaska in a landscape grid of 1 square kilometer (km²) cells and again in a grid of 10 km² cells, which are finer resolutions than most models of net CO₂ have achieved.
例句.中文: 水文学家 Yonghong Yi 及其同事先以 1 平方公里、再以 10 平方公里的网格，建模模拟阿拉斯加净 CO₂ 的季节变化——这样的分辨率比大多数净 CO₂ 模型所达到的都要精细。

例句.英文: High-resolution images show these eruptions produce thin streams of hot gas moving at speeds between 55 and 200 kilometers per second.
例句.中文: 高分辨率图像显示，这些喷发产生细束状热气流，速度在每秒 55 至 200 公里之间。

义项: 动词 正式记录在案（a registered trademark 注册商标）
动词 (引申义) 显示出、流露出（register surprise 显出惊讶）；名词「登记簿、语域」

例句.英文: In the US, "Q-tips" is a registered trademark of the company Unilever.
例句.中文: 在美国，「Q-tips」是联合利华公司的注册商标。

例句.英文: In 2021, there were a total of1,051 merchant vessels registered in Cyprus. ·The combined DWT of these vessels was 34 million tons.
例句.中文: 2021 年，在塞浦路斯注册的商船共 1,051 艘；这些船舶的载重吨位合计 3,400 万吨。

义项: 名词 竞赛中的优胜者（a defending champion 卫冕冠军）
动词 拥护、捍卫（champion a cause 捍卫某项事业）

例句.英文: Though John Crowley, author of Flint and Mirror, is perhaps not as well known as the most commercially successful American writers of the past fifty years, his work has had several influential champions, including the poet James Merrill and the literary critic Harold Bloom.
例句.中文: 尽管《燧石与镜子》的作者约翰·克劳利或许不如过去五十年间商业上最成功的美国作家那样广为人知，但他的作品一直……

例句.英文: During the 1952 New York ticker-tape parade for US Olympic champions, the ribbonlike swirls descending on the scene were paper spools from “tickers," telegraph machines used to transmit stock prices.
例句.中文: 1952 年纽约为美国奥运冠军举行的纸带游行中，如彩带般盘旋而下的，是「行情机」——用于传送股价的电报机——吐出的纸卷。

义项: 动词 正式委托某人制作某物（commissioned the Luttrell Psalter 委托制作《卢特雷尔诗篇》）
名词 委员会；佣金（a sales commission 销售佣金）

例句.英文: Sir Geoffrey Luttrell commissioned the Luttrell Psalter, a celebrated document of religious songs and images of life in medieval England. Not all of Luttrell's actions were admirable, however.
例句.中文: 杰弗里·卢特雷尔爵士委托制作了《卢特雷尔诗篇》——一部著名的宗教歌咏与中世纪英格兰生活图像文献。

例句.英文: The first public library became available in Rome in 28 BCE and was soon followed by one commissioned by Emperor Augustus.
例句.中文: 第一座公共图书馆于公元前 28 年在罗马向公众开放，不久之后奥古斯都大帝又敕建了一座。
